chart.title: Share of adults who drank alcohol in last year
chart.subtitle: Adults are defined as those aged 15 years and older. Shown is the share of adults who have drunk any alcohol in the preceding 12 months.
chart.citation: World Health Organization – Global Health Observatory (2026)
